items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I knew him. I used to meet him in New York with Ed Berger, we used to go see him play, and he would come and talk to me at the table.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’ll tell you who has probably very good insight, and you should talk to him if you haven’t already, is Loren Schoenberg at the Jazz Museum in Harlem. Because he worked with Benny for a number of years. And he got the full treatment, everything from praise to damnation, he got the whole thing. And Benny took his band away from him eventually. He took off his gloves man.
Touché. You know Joe Wilder, he went on that tour to Russia.
